 Order
This is fourth application filed under section 439 of Cr.P.C in crime no.364/2022 under sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 344 of IPC and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act registered at police station Khargone.
The third application has already been rejected on merits after considering the testimony of the prosecutrix and the date of birth of the prosecutrix recorded in the scholar register.
Accordingly, the present application stands dismissed.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Sourabh Sawan @ Kalu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128425672/
